reason: I've had a sore throat for a week with chills and fatigue.
diagnosis: Acute streptococcal pharyngitis is most likely, given the week of sore throat, chills, fatigue, painful swallowing, red throat, tender neck lumps, and absence of cough or coryzal symptoms; infectious mononucleosis is an alternative.
keyPoints: Sore throat severity and painful swallowing
Cough, runny nose, congestion, or other viral symptoms
Neck lumps/tender cervical lymph nodes and throat exam findings
Exposure to sick contacts / recent similar illness in boyfriend
Features of mono: marked fatigue, tonsillar exudate, abdominal pain/splenomegaly, sports/exertion risk
Past medical history, medications, allergies, and immunization status
manner: mildly worried, cooperative, gives brief answers
